name: Two Pointers
signals: Linear structure (array/LL/string), process pairs at two positions, often sorted input.

name: Fast and Slow Pointers
signals: Linear structure; cycle detection, middle element, intersection of two lists.

name: Sliding Window
signals: Contiguous subarray/substring; repeated computation on a moving window; longest/shortest with a constraint.

name: Merge Intervals
signals: Input is intervals (meetings, bookings); overlaps, gaps, conflicts. Sort by start, compare with previous.

name: In-place LL Manipulation
signals: Restructure a linked list without changing node data, O(1) space. prev/curr/next.

name: Heaps
signals: Stream of data, repeated min/max, median, custom priority selection.

name: K-way Merge
signals: Merge K sorted lists/arrays/matrix rows; Kth smallest across sorted collections. Min heap of heads.

name: Top K Elements
signals: Subset of largest/smallest/most frequent from unsorted data. Heap of size K.

name: Modified Binary Search
signals: Sorted or partially sorted (rotated) data; first/last occurrence; search on the answer space.

name: Subsets
signals: Generate combinations, permutations or the power set.

name: Greedy
signals: Optimisation where a locally optimal choice is globally optimal; usually after sorting.

name: Backtracking
signals: Explore every choice to find all/any feasible solution; prune dead ends; grid word search.

name: Dynamic Programming
signals: Overlapping subproblems + optimal substructure; count ways / min / max.

name: Cyclic Sort
signals: Integers in a small known range (1..n); find missing or duplicate values in place.

name: Topological Sort
signals: Dependencies / prerequisites forming a partial order; produce a valid order or detect a cycle.

name: Sort and Search
signals: Sort first, then binary search / two pointers on ordered relationships.

name: Matrices
signals: 2D array manipulation: rotate, spiral, in-place marking.

name: Stacks
signals: Nested structures (brackets), reverse-order processing, expression evaluation, next greater element.

name: Graphs
signals: Network of related objects or a grid; connectivity, shortest path (BFS / Dijkstra), flood fill.

name: Tree DFS
signals: Binary tree, answer built along root-to-leaf paths or from children (post-order); LCA, path sums.

name: Tree BFS
signals: Binary tree level-by-level; level order, views, nearest to the root.

name: Trie
signals: Prefix matching, autocomplete, dictionary of words.

name: Hash Maps
signals: Repeated O(1) lookups, pairwise relations, grouping by key.

name: Knowing What to Track
signals: Frequency counting then using the counts; fixed alphabet; prefix sums with a map.

name: Union Find
signals: Group elements by a property; merge sets; connectivity / cycle in undirected edges.

name: Custom Data Structures
signals: Design a class combining structures (map + list etc.) with O(1) ops: LRU, min stack.

name: Bitwise Manipulation
signals: Bit-level tricks: XOR to cancel pairs, masks.

name: Math and Geometry
signals: Number theory or geometric reasoning.
